description: This file defines the 'Gdpr' controller class within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It handles GDPR-related email notifications, specifically for GDPR data requests and data removal, including generating email content and queuing email tasks.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Controller class managing GDPR email notifications for user data requests and deletions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GDPR email request notifications by preparing email content and queuing email tasks based on user request.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Handles GDPR data removal notifications by preparing and queuing email tasks to notify users about data deletion.
